## Key Medical Specialties & Procedures
- Micro-Incision Cataract Surgery (MICS): Blade-free, stitchless phacoemulsification with imported premium Foldable Intraocular Lenses (IOL). 15-minute procedure, same-day recovery.
- LASIK & Contoura Vision Refractive Surgery: Permanent freedom from spectacles with topography-guided laser vision correction.
- Glaucoma Medical & Surgical Care: Early intraocular pressure (IOP) diagnosis, perimeter testing, and laser trabeculoplasty.
- Pediatric Ophthalmology & Squint: Children's vision assessment, lazy eye (amblyopia) therapy, and strabismus management.
- Low Vision Rehabilitation: Comprehensive vision enhancement devices and optical aids for visually impaired individuals.
- Prescription Optical Store: Doctor-verified power lenses (Digital Blue Cut Anti-Glare, HD Progressive) and ultralight titanium/acetate frames.
